description: Source code for URL manipulation functions related to app key extraction and encoding, including stripping user info, query, and fragment from URLs, and encoding app keys in base64 with URL-safe characters.

methods.name: StripUserInfo
methods.description: Removes username and password from a URL string if present.

methods.name: StripQuery
methods.description: Removes the query part from a URL string if present.

methods.name: StripFragment
methods.description: Removes the fragment part from a URL string if present.

methods.name: ExtractAppKey
methods.description: Extracts the base URL without user info, query, or fragment.

methods.name: EncodeAppKey
methods.description: Encodes an app key string into URL-safe base64 format.
